name: Themewant Sale Timer for WooCommerce
author: Mahabub Alam

sections.description:
Sale Timer for WooCommerce automatically shows a simple message like:

“Sale ends in 3 days”

on WooCommerce single product pages when a sale end date is set.

It helps create urgency for customers without adding heavy scripts or complex settings.

Features

  • Automatically detects WooCommerce sale end date
  • Displays remaining days on single product pages
  • Hides automatically when the sale ends
  • Lightweight and theme-independent
  • No configuration required
sections.installation:
1. Upload the sale timer for woocommerce folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress
  3. Set a sale price and sale end date for any WooCommerce product
sections.faq:
Does this work without a sale end date?

No. SaleRush only shows the message when a sale end date is scheduled.

Does it work with all themes?

Yes. SaleRush uses standard WooCommerce hooks and works with all properly coded themes.
